Name: Arutani
Remark: Arutani (Uruak, Awake). Single speaker, Juanita Martinez (born in Makô, upper Paragua, Venezuela; lives in Saúba, Uraricaá river, Roraima, Brazil); data collected by T. Chacon and team (PRODOCLIN/Museu do Índio), c. 2019-2024. Language-level Glottocode: the speaker's variety is not identified with Glottolog's Uruak or Awake dialect nodes.
